item.title: ▫️ Closing pincers A storming soldier with the call sign 'Iven' told about the liberation of Voskresenka:
item.description: Closing pincers ▫️ 💬 A storming soldier with the call sign 'Iven' told about the liberation of Voskresenka: 'The settlement was quite fortified. Supply routes were reinforced by tripwires and hedgehogs. At first, they tried to hold on to the defence, but the defence was overwhelmed. We're shutting the pocket, and Voskresenka is only left.' 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: ❗️ The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue to launch strikes by unmanned aerial vehicles against ships with military equipment and dual-use cargo.
item.description: ❗️ The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue to launch strikes by unmanned aerial vehicles against ships with military equipment and dual-use cargo. 💥 In the course of the day, two dry cargo ships with weapons and materiel were hit in the Black Sea south-west of Odessa and in the port of Chernomorsk of Odessa region. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry
